messages:
alex wong: opened a PR to add a migration/playbook for 429s, timeouts, and context-limit fallbacks. covers server-side retries, SDK snippets (JS/Python/Go), and a small migration checklist. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482
mira patel: thanks — skimmed. Left 3 inline comments re: wording and the fallback table. Can you add a small decision matrix for when to use caching vs fallback model?
jordan k: would be great to include concrete code for: exponential backoff + jitter, and an example of trimming prompt to fit context. both JS and py please.
sam riley: +1. Also recommend an ops note about "observability knobs" (latency/budget alarms) and a snippet showing token-cost breakdown from console.
lee choi: added a tiny prompt-trim helper in the thread. Paste into PR?
lee choi: ```js
// trim to keep latest 2048 tokens (approx)
function trimConversation(conv, maxTokens=2048){
  while(estimatedTokens(conv) > maxTokens){
    conv.shift(); // drop oldest user/assistant turns
  }
  return conv;
}
```
mira patel: can we also show SDK usage for immediate fallback? e.g., call model with low-latency tier and fallback to cheaper quantized variant on 429. sample pseudocode?
alex wong: added a "fallback policy" snippet in PR draft. Quick paste here:
alex wong: ```py
# try fast tier, on 429 switch to quantized model
try:
  res = client.generate(model="fast-llm", prompt=prompt, timeout=2.0)
except APIError as e:
  if e.code == 429:
    res = client.generate(model="fast-llm-quantized", prompt=prompt, timeout=4.0)
```
jordan k: might want to use response.headers['x-rate-limit-retry-after'] when present instead of immediate retry.
sam riley: agree, add note about respecting Retry-After and link to header docs -> https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Headers/Retry-After (or our API reference?)
mira patel: I made wording edits, and added a short "what not to do" callout (e.g., increasing concurrency without caching). Also flagged a missing link to SDK retry config page.
alex wong: thanks. i'll add JS/Python snippet for backoff + jitter and a one-paragraph migration checklist:
alex wong: - audit: list endpoints, token sizes, and latency targets
alex wong: - add client-level retry wrappers + centralize in service
alex wong: - add local prompt-trim and prefix caching (examples)
alex wong: - run smoke test against dedicated capacity
jordan k: FYI — small unit test suggestion: simulate 429 from mocked service and assert fallback selected.
lee choi: PR link updated with examples: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482/files
ci-bot: build passed for docs PR #482 :white_check_mark:
mira patel: does anyone want to own merging after alex adds snippets? I can do final pass after code is in.
sam riley: I can test the snippets against the SDK tomorrow morning.
alex wong: i'll push the JS + py backoff/jitter snippets tonight. tagging @mira for final review.
mira patel: perfect :thumbsup:
